g_m_s2.note: standard gravity; local gravity at the study site differs by about 0.1 %

pressure_Pa.verification_test: Barometric record at the chosen coastal parcel

composition_mole_fraction.units: mole fraction, dry air, rounded to four places

vent_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002 (open site; vents and stacks discharge to outside air)

oxidant.note: air carries O2 at the composition above

cooling_dry_bulb_C.note: summer extreme; cooling is never the governing load

heating_dry_bulb_C.verification_test: Metocean record at the chosen parcel; the station record low is the bounding design value (A-M-392)

pv_yield_kWh_kWp_d.units: kWh/kWp/d annual average (summer-only; zero through the dark season)
pv_yield_kWh_kWp_d.verification_test: PVWatts run at the mooring latitude with the polar-day/night solar geometry

night_hours.note: south of 66.5 S the sun is below the horizon for weeks through the austral winter. The worst stretch is the polar night (months). Wind generation is the diverse winter source; the hydrogen bank and fuel cell are the seasonal store. This daily figure is a placeholder - the seasonal sizing is the X-LOC-08 design pass.

basic_wind_speed_m_s.units: m/s basic wind speed (gusts above 100 kn at McMurdo)
basic_wind_speed_m_s.verification_test: Class or ASCE Hazard Tool at the chosen parcel with site metocean data

roof_snow_kPa.units: kPa drift load on flat roof (study)

seismic.not_applicable: Coastal volcanic ground with permafrost; the governing lateral loads are wind and snow drift (AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2)

allowable_bearing_kPa.units: kPa allowable bearing, presumptive volcanic gravel
allowable_bearing_kPa.verification_test: Geotechnical investigation at the parcel: permafrost depth, bearing and thaw-settlement potential

resistivity_ohm_m.verification_test: Four-pin resistivity survey at the parcel

ghex_capacity_W_m.units: W/m (ground-loop heat exchange not viable in frozen permafrost)
ghex_capacity_W_m.note: the ground loop is eliminated at this site

radiation.not_applicable: Earth surface under the atmosphere: natural background only

value.name: seawater_ro
value.treatment: seawater intake warmed with process waste heat then reverse osmosis; discharge per Madrid Protocol Annex III

feed_cases.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (Article 7 prohibits mineral resource activity; local feed limited to station waste and returned cargo; environmental evaluation under Annex I is Q-025)

arrival_mode.value: ship and aircraft, summer season only (December to February)
arrival_mode.verification_test: Logistics study: the resupply window sets hold_d values and spares holding

resupply_interval_d.verification_test: Logistics study: the annual interval sets product hold_d and spares

ac_frequency_Hz.units: Hz line frequency (IEC 60034-30-1 60 Hz IE3 basis, AQS-INV-005)

earthing_method.value: earth electrode grid in frozen volcanic ground; sea return as supplement
earthing_method.note: frozen permafrost has very high resistivity

code_families.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (the Antarctic Treaty family added on top of the operating state's law)

value.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (wind is the diverse winter source at McMurdo-class sites)
AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (PV produces nothing through the dark season)

sources.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (wind carries the dark season; hydrogen bank is the seasonal store)

value.note: seasonal hydrogen store sized for the dark season (the X-LOC-08 design pass)

storage.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2; seasonal hydrogen replaces pumped hydro (frozen reservoirs)

value.note: the worst stretch is the austral polar night (about 120 days south of 66.5 S), not a daily night. Seasonal sizing is the X-LOC-08 design pass.

oversize_factor.units: PV nameplate / PV needed to close the daily balance
oversize_factor.verification_test: Polar-day/night solar geometry plus the wind resource; the seasonal model is the X-LOC-08 design pass

value.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (seasonal hydrogen store replaces pumped hydro; frozen reservoirs)
AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (ground loop not viable in frozen permafrost; the dry cooler becomes a heat-recovery coil)
redundancy: the heat-recovery pair serves rejection and the seawater-intake warming duty

buoyant_separation.register: AQS-SITE-002; gravity.g_m_s2 above zero, steady in direction (fixed foundation)

air_heat_sink.register: AQS-SITE-002; open site; cooling design dry bulb AQS-SITE-002

ground_contact.register: AQS-SITE-008; coastal volcanic ground with permafrost

liquid_water_at_ambient.register: AQS-SITE-002; atmosphere.pressure_Pa above the triple point of water
liquid_water_at_ambient.note: seawater at -2 C requires waste-heat warming before RO (the McMurdo practice); freeze protection on all water lines

value.register: AQS-PLAN-011 section 7.2 (the dry cooler becomes a heat-recovery coil: rejected heat is a resource at this site)
